summary: Frontend-only auth/session regression completed on public web URL with mobile viewport. Auto-open session persistence, internal-route reload behavior, logout persistence, forced /auth/me 401 handling, non-401 handling, password visibility toggle, and book PDF web regression were validated.

ui_bugs.issue: Measured interactive element box for `login-password-visibility` is 23x23 on web, below requested 44x44 minimum touch target.

issues: Password visibility icon target appears undersized for touch ergonomics (requested >=44).

action_items: Increase the practical touch area of `login-password-visibility` to >=44x44 (e.g., explicit width/height on Pressable) while keeping current toggle behavior.
Optional: add a stable testID on auth-loading container to make transient redirect checks more deterministic.
Run one native-device confirmation pass (iOS/Android) for SecureStore persistence semantics; web validation completed using storage shim and live API.
critical_code_review_comments: No biometric remnants found in app code/config under tested scope: no `expo-local-authentication` dependency, no biometric permissions (`USE_BIOMETRIC`/`USE_FINGERPRINT`), no lock-screen flow references.
Auth persistence path remains token-only: `TOKEN_KEY=racontelle_token` via `secureSet/secureGet/secureRemove`; no password persistence implementation found.
On forced `/api/auth/me` 401, token was cleared (observed local storage token length became 0) and app returned to unauthenticated flow.
On forced non-401 (`503`) for `/api/auth/me`, app did not treat session validation as success (returned to auth flow), and resumed authenticated opening once API recovered.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated with verification@racontelle.fr / Souvenir123 on https://family-stories-34.preview.emergentagent.com. Login -> reload -> home auto-open works. Internal route `/profile` reload stays authenticated. Voluntary logout persists across reload. Forced `/api/auth/me` 401 logs out and clears token; forced 503 does not falsely authenticate. Password visibility toggles and preserves value; book PDF web summary shown: 'PDF prêt : 2 histoires incluses.'
rca_of_issue: Password visibility touch-target gap: the icon Pressable currently renders with ~23x23 box and relies on `hitSlop={8}`. Effective interaction area is still below requested 44 minimum in web measurement. Mitigation: enforce explicit 44x44 Pressable container (or larger) for the toggle control.
